description: Would not give a figure the cloth does not hold, and would not strike a share.
name: John Heminges

description: Brought the close into the parlour, and her sentence with it.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took a day without a sum, and set the shut door beside Thursday's two dogs.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for a number, was refused, and kept the Mayor's sentence.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused a share for the page, kept the twenty pounds off the cloth, and would not open the coffer.
name: William Shakespeare
